affected_component: product_jobs candidate generation smoke step + workspace_bundle.run_workspace_smoke stderr_sink + draft_selfcheck routing + product_preflight smoke detail
invariant: For a runnable contract, candidate generation runs the contract's smoke command on the first sealed reference workspace with the same run_workspace_smoke ruler preflight uses after freeze; a failure is WORKSPACE_REFERENCE_SMOKE_FAILED with the smoke codes, exit code and a bounded stderr excerpt as public diagnostics, routed producer-first then contract. The smoke evidence keeps only hashes; the excerpt travels through an explicit stderr_sink, which the preflight detail now uses as well. Non-runnable contracts never run smoke.
